You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Considering the provided chest X-rays, which of the following statements best describes the progression of the patient's lung condition from the initial presentation to the six-week follow-up?

A) The size of the largest cavity decreased, with resolution of air-fluid levels, and there was no significant change in consolidation.
B) The largest cavity increased in size with a new appearance of air-fluid levels, while consolidation significantly worsened.
C) The size of the largest cavity decreased, with resolution of air-fluid levels, and there was significant improvement in consolidation.
D) The largest cavity remained unchanged, with persistent air-fluid levels, and consolidation slightly improved.
E) The size of the largest cavity decreased, with new air-fluid levels forming, and consolidation slightly worsened.
F) The largest cavity increased in size, with resolution of air-fluid levels, and consolidation significantly improved.
